column2:
Burger
-> Our burger is served in a large, authentic American-style portion that can easily make you feel full on its own, with fresh ingredients. The seasoning and sauces are carefully developed and prepared by a chef with 15 years of experience.
Black n’ Bleu Mushroom Burger
Smoky chargrilled beef with earthy mushrooms and sharp blue cheese. Rich, savory, slightly tangy with creamy and crispy onion contrast.

Surf & Turf Burger
Juicy grilled beef paired with crispy beer-battered shrimp. Bold, savory-meaty with a light sweet seafood note and crunchy texture.

Chicken Bacon Mushroom Burger
Tender grilled chicken with smoky bacon and earthy mushrooms. Savory, slightly smoky and creamy with nutty cheese and garlic aioli.

Philly Cheese Steak
Thin-sliced beef with sautéed onions and mushrooms. Deeply savory, rich umami flavor with creamy melted four-cheese sauce.
column3:
Burger
-> We understand that kids love burgers, but don’t mistake us for fast food. Every ingredient is carefully selected, must be fresh, and quality-checked, ensuring a dish that kids enjoy while parents can feel reassured.
California Chicken Burger
Chargrilled chicken with creamy smashed avocado, fried egg, and cheddar. Fresh, rich and creamy with a mix of buttery, savory and slightly smoky flavors.

Barnyard Burger
Chargrilled U.S. beef with bacon, cheddar, and fried egg. Bold, hearty and savory with smoky, salty richness and a soft-yolk creamy finish.

Buffalo Chicken Sandwich
Crispy battered chicken coated in spicy Buffalo sauce with bleu cheese. Spicy, tangy and savory with a crispy bite and cooling creamy contrast.
column4:
Pasta
Don’t worry about eating pasta and still feeling hungry. Here, we always serve generous portions. The flavors are approachable and easy to enjoy, and this dish is especially romantic.
Spaghetti Bolognese
Classic spaghetti with rich meaty tomato sauce and Parmesan. Savory, slightly tangy and hearty with deep umami from slow-cooked beef.

Steak Fajita Pasta
Spaghetti with medium-grilled U.S. top blade steak in a tomato cream sauce. Bold, savory and slightly creamy with smoky beef and light tangy richness.

Chicken & Mushroom Alfredo Pasta
Spaghetti in creamy Alfredo sauce with sautéed chicken and mushrooms. Rich, buttery and savory with smooth creaminess and earthy umami notes.

Creamy Pesto Shrimp Pasta
Pan-seared shrimp with spaghetti in creamy pesto sauce and Parmesan. Fresh basil aroma, nutty richness and a light seafood sweetness with creamy texture.

column2:
Steak
Steak is available everywhere, but here you can choose from six signature sauces based on the restaurant’s own recipes. The steak is grilled, carrying a subtle smoky aroma, while remaining refined, flavorful, and easy to enjoy.
Ribeye (200g)
Rich, well-marbled U.S. ribeye with a juicy, beefy and slightly buttery flavor. Served with roasted baby potatoes and steamed vegetables for a balanced, hearty plate.

Filet Mignon (180g)
Lean and extremely tender U.S. tenderloin with a mild, delicate beef flavor and soft buttery texture. Served with mashed potatoes, sautéed mushrooms, and asparagus for a smooth, elegant balance.

Pub Steak (200g)
U.S. top blade steak with a firm bite and bold, beefy flavor. Slightly smoky and savory, paired with crispy fries and grilled vegetables for a classic, satisfying pub-style meal.
column3:
Chicken Tenders
Crispy battered chicken breast, golden and juicy inside. Mild savory flavor with crunchy coating, served with dipping sauces ranging from sweet, tangy to spicy.

Chicken Wings
Crispy fried wings with bold, juicy bite and rich savory flavor. Coated in your choice of sauce: sweet BBQ, spicy Buffalo, or tangy honey mustard for sweet, spicy or balanced profiles.

Mac n’ Cheese Bites
Creamy mac and cheese encased in a crispy fried shell. Rich, cheesy and indulgent inside with a crunchy exterior, paired with spicy ranch for a creamy-spicy contrast.

Loaded Chili Fries
Crispy fries topped with hearty beef chili, melted cheddar and fresh green onions. Savory, cheesy and slightly spicy with a rich, comforting and filling flavor profile.
column4:
Nachos
Nachos is a dish we are especially proud of, as we have showcased it at numerous food fairs and stalls, where the lines of people waiting to try it have consistently been surprisingly long.
Spicy Buffalo Chicken Nachos
Crispy corn tortilla nachos loaded with cheese and grilled chicken in Buffalo sauce. Spicy, tangy and savory with a crunchy base and creamy melted cheese.

Texas Nachos
Corn tortilla nachos topped with hearty beef chili, melted cheeses, and fresh toppings. Rich, savory and slightly spicy with a bold, loaded and satisfying bite.

column2:
Rare dishes
Two rare dishes on a typical Western restaurant menu in Hanoi, try them once, and you’ll likely keep coming back for more.
Chicken and Waffles
Crispy fried chicken with a warm, fluffy waffle. Sweet and savory combo with crunchy chicken, soft waffle and a spicy maple syrup finish.

Fluffy Pancake
Soft, airy pancakes served with fresh fruits and maple syrup. Light, sweet and slightly buttery with a fresh, fruity balance.
column3:
Waffle Sundae
Freshly made waffle served warm with vanilla ice cream, whipped cream, and chocolate sauce. Sweet, creamy and rich with a contrast between warm crisp waffle and cold, smooth ice cream.

Milkshake
Creamy blended ice cream milkshake topped with whipped cream, Oreo crumbles, and chocolate swirl. Thick, sweet and indulgent with a mix of chocolate richness and cookies-and-cream texture.
-> Even adults can’t resist desserts, let alone kids. These are the kinds of treats children often see in cartoons, and they would be thrilled to try them at least once.
column4:
BBQ Pork Ribs
Smoky grilled pork ribs glazed in sweet BBQ sauce. Tender, juicy and fall-off-the-bone with a rich, sweet-savory flavor, served with fries and coleslaw for a balanced, hearty meal.

~200.000 for burger and ~350.000 for steak
It may sound pricey, but the portion size and the completeness of the flavor make it worth it.
column3: with under 800.000, your family can be satisfied

column2:
S&L DIner có phải quán ăn phù hợp cho gia đình không? 
- S&L Diner là quán ăn dành cho gia đình với đa dạng các món từ chiên rán, nướng, salad, tráng miệng. Đồ ăn kiểu Mỹ chuẩn rất được lòng các bạn trẻ nhưng sự chuyên nghiệp và đậm đà của món ăn cũng sẽ làm hài lòng thực khách lớn tuổi. Đầu bếp của chúng tôi luôn sẵn lòng hỗ trợ các gia đình điều chỉnh lại thành phần nhỏ trong món ăn để phù hợp với cả người cao tuổi. Không gian quán rộng rãi, phong cách trang trí ấm cúng cùng chút nhạc nhẹ giúp không khí của bữa ăn gia đình thoải mái hơn nhiều.
column3:
S&L Diner khác gì so với các nhà hàng đồ Tây khác ở Hà Nội?
S&L Diner là nhà hàng American Diner đầu tiên và duy nhất tại Hà Nội, thành lập từ năm 2016 và được điều hành bởi đầu bếp người Mỹ Steven Kaczerski với hơn 15 năm kinh nghiệm. Thực đơn của chúng tôi không chỉ có những món kinh điển được làm với hương vị chuẩn nhất như Nachos, Burger hay Steak mà còn món ăn khó tìm như MilkShake, Chicken&Wafles, and Fully Pancake. Ngoài ra chúng tôi còn phục vụ cả bữa sáng nha.
column4:
S&L Diner phục vụ vào lúc nào?
 S&L Diner phục vụ All-Day Breakfast trong suốt giờ mở cửa, bao gồm Pancakes, Waffles, Biscuits and Gravy và các món trứng kiểu Mỹ. Nhà hàng mở cửa 365 ngày trong năm từ 11 giờ sáng đến 10 giờ tối, kể cả ngày lễ và Tết. Khách có thể ăn tại chỗ hoặc đặt mang về, đồ mang về được bọc giấy bạc đảm bảo chất lượng.
